run_findings.mcp_pre_task_creation_seam: EXACT_SOURCE_CONFIRMED: C# SDK v2.2.0 exposes public experimental CallToolWithAlternateFilters. WithTasks appends its filter at the current end; alternate filters registered before it run before task creation. A side-effect-free requestState preflight can therefore short-circuit before CreateTaskAsync.
run_findings.mcp_tool_body_mrtr: NOT_COMPOSABLE_WITH_TASKS_IN_STOCK_PATH: exact WithTasks catches InputRequiredException from the background tool pipeline and stores failure saying MRTR and tasks cannot be composed via [McpServerTool] yet. Preflight must return InputRequiredResult directly from the outer alternate filter.
run_findings.mcp_deterministic_task_identity: SOURCE_EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE_RECOVERY_PROVED: custom store can use verified server-minted op_id as its unique taskId, atomically persist task+intent, and fail duplicate CreateTaskAsync before Task.Run. Outer filter catches duplicate and returns existing verified CreateTaskResult. Lost response and concurrent identical retries schedule one effect in fixtures.
run_findings.mcp_create_schedule_orphan: NEW STOCK GAP: RunAsTaskAsync awaits durable CreateTaskAsync before volatile Task.Run scheduling. Crash in between leaves a durable Working task with no execution. Returning the recovered handle bypasses Tasks and does not redrive the orphan. Therefore deterministic identity closes unknown-handle duplication but is not full crash-safe execution.
run_findings.mcp_three_property_split: REVISED: separately prove (1) handle rediscovery/duplicate-safe creation, (2) execution liveness/re-drive after scheduler crash, and (3) external-effect duplicate safety. A task ID or durable task row proves only (1); a lease/generation without effect-side idempotency/CAS cannot prove (3).
